basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old guy from Richmond, VA, exploring my interests in the ABDL community. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me flexible hours to dive into my hobbies, including gaming and watching animated series like Arcane. I'm single and open to new connections, both friendly and potentially romantic, especially with like-minded individuals. I usually hop online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. I'm fairly new to Reddit but eager to engage more with communities that align with my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having completed a degree in Visual Arts. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on projects and online courses. I'm also a gaming enthusiast, diving into modding communities like H3VRMods to enhance my gaming experience.
